text_block_list.text:
In preparation for the Fan Fest, Special
Week and
company are rehearsing their
costumed hero play.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, Эль Кондор Паса distances
herself,
claiming she can't participate
because she's
chosen a different path.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But it was just a lie to shock everyone!
She
surprises her friends by jumping into
practice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса has fun practicing for the
hero
play with all of her friends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The qualities of an entertainer—a focus
on fun
and amazement—are an
important virtue she
inherited from her
father.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
